scripts.studio:build: vite build --config vite.studio.config.ts && esbuild src/studio/main/main.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --external:electron --outfile=dist-studio/main.cjs && esbuild src/studio/main/preload.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --external:electron --outfile=dist-studio/preload.cjs && npm run cli:build && npm run remotion:bundle
scripts.cli:build: esbuild scripts/validate-script.ts scripts/generate-voices.ts scripts/generate-timeline.ts scripts/preview.ts scripts/generate-video.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --external:@remotion/bundler --external:@remotion/renderer --outdir=dist-cli --out-extension:.js=.cjs
scripts.release:local: npm run make && npm sbom --sbom-format cyclonedx > out/release-sbom.cdx.json && npm run verify:package
scripts.release:public: RELEASE_PUBLIC=1 npm run make && npm sbom --sbom-format cyclonedx > out/release-sbom.cdx.json && npm run verify:release
scripts.test:studio:e2e: esbuild src/studio/main/preload.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --external:electron --outfile=dist-studio/preload.cjs && esbuild tests/studio/asset-electron.e2e.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --packages=external --outfile=dist-studio/asset-electron.e2e.mjs && electron dist-studio/asset-electron.e2e.mjs
